observations.operation: initialize TextAttr.ta_Flags at its stack-built structure byte to 0x43, combining ROM, DISK and DESIGNED selection bits
when ReadArgs result slot 3 (PROP) is nonzero, replace ta_Flags with 0x63, adding FPF_PROPORTIONAL (0x20)
when ReadArgs result slot 2 (SCALE) is nonzero, clear FPF_DESIGNED (0x40) from ta_Flags

layout_evidence.source: CopperSharp SDK Graphics.TextAttr field order, matching the HUNK's structure construction

conclusion: SCALE clears FPF_DESIGNED and PROP adds FPF_PROPORTIONAL; the two switches are independent and may be combined.
evidence_limits: This records the original HUNK's TextAttr construction; actual diskfont selection and console behavior still require original Workbench guest comparison.
